newsitem.title: USA: SITEL Corp to buy L&R Group of London.
newsitem.headline: SITEL Corp to buy L&R Group of London.

text.p: SITEL Corp said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire L&R Group Ltd, a teleservices consulting firm based in London.
Financial terms of the stock-and-cash deal were not disclosed.
SITEL said the deal will expand its service options in Europe since L&R has clients in the publishing, insurance, telecommunications and consumer publishing markets.
SITEL provides outsourced telephone-based customer service and sales programs to large corporations.
Its shares closed down 1/2 Tuesday at 16-3/8.
